rules.BREAKOUT_CONTINUATION: New confirmed close breakout; EMA direction agrees, ADX>=25 and relative volume>=1.5.
rules.BREAKOUT_RETEST: Within8 bars after breakout (not same bar), touch0.25ATR level zone and confirming directional body/close beyond0.1ATR.
rules.FAILED_BREAKOUT_REVERSAL: Within8 closed bars of breakout, close back through broken level by0.1ATR; choose opposite side.
rules.RANGE_MEAN_REVERSION: ADX<=20 and prior50 width<=6ATR; range position<=.15 with RSI<=40 LONG or >=.85 and RSI>=60 SHORT.
rules.TREND_PULLBACK: ADX>=25, full15m/1h/4h EMA alignment, pullback depth0.5..2ATR and directional candle body.
rules.VOLATILITY_EXPANSION: ATR/close versus previous64 median>=1.5, volume>=1.5, breakout in EMA direction.

safety: OFFLINE_ONLY; no web routing, private-account imports, portfolio DB access or execution activation.
